caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical object resembling a lantern or container with a weathered, metallic appearance, predominantly in dark gray and brown tones with areas of rust and lighter patches indicating wear. The object has a wide, arched handle attached at the top and side, and a rounded, dome-shaped top with ridges. On the body of the object, there is a rectangular panel, also showing signs of rust and discoloration. The object casts a slight shadow, indicating its three-dimensional form, and the background is plain and beige with faint, irregular patches of a pale orange color. In the lower right corner, there is a lightly inscribed signature reading "HARRY GROSSEN."
title: Lantern
